appDescription.message: Formats or removes quoted reply text and original-message headers in Gmail replies.

removeQuoteHelp.message: Deletes the quoted original message from replies.

adjustQuoteStyleHelp.message: Removes the left quote line or leading quote marks from quoted text in replies.

rewriteHeaderHelp.message: Formats the sender, date, subject, and To line in an Outlook-style header.

settingsNote.message: This extension automatically expands quoted content when you reply.
